scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('dist/deployments',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../deployments'))if(f.endsWith('.json'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('../deployments',f),p.join('dist/deployments',f));fs.mkdirSync('dist/anchor',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('../anchor/stellar.toml','dist/anchor/stellar.toml');console.log('copied the deployment manifest and stellar.toml into dist')"
